name: metavr_cli_help
description: Help for the metavr CLI (Meta's `@meta-quest/hzdb`, the Quest device dev tool). Call BEFORE invoking a metavr subcommand from the shell — metavr gets new subcommands every release (perf capture, ovrmetrics, ui automation, sideload, meta-assets search, etc.) and your training data does not include them. Pass `topic` for one subcommand (e.g. 'perf', 'app', 'device', 'docs', 'ui'); omit for the full tree. Returns markdown.

topic.description: Specific subcommand to get help docs for (e.g., 'adb', 'device'). If not specified, returns help docs for all top-level metavr commands.
